entities.summary: Volodymyr Matviichuk is a Ukrainian amateur lightweight boxer. He won a bronze medal at the 2011 European Championships and competed at the 2016 Olympics, where he was eliminated in the first bout. Matviichuk has degrees in economics and coaching from Zhytomyr State Technological University.
